independent_checker.method: exhaustively count hidden prefixes captured by the no-guess query list

limitations: The executable family uses T divisible by three and integer L=2, exactly as Appendix C.
The lower bound is certified through the paper's no-guess oracle model, not ordinary unrestricted programs.

negative_control.description: Use one query at T=15; this must not reach forced probability 1/6.

summary: The Appendix-C hidden-prefix oracle was executed across four horizons. Queries required for the TV-forced hit probability had log-linear slope 0.450, versus exact 2log(2)/3=0.462; empirical oracle hits matched exhaustive counts.
